description: Requires the account session, current X-Organization-Id and CSRF for writes. Set up to three known DKIM selectors and choose whether IP rotation is expected. Expected rotation keeps history without notices; alias changes still notify. Does not discover selectors, enable monitoring or authenticate sent messages. Send manual_expires_on, dns, or both. Omitted settings are preserved. DNS requires both selectors and rotating_addresses. An identical retry is idempotent. A conflicting revision returns 409.

dns.description: Known selectors and expected IP rotation. Selector discovery is not performed.

revision.description: Current revision from the corresponding settings or monitor. Use zero for the first change.
